title: IS17_inheritance1_1

lines.explanation: declare a class Person
creates a private instance field called name of type String
creates a new method called 'setName' that takes a string input.
assigns the value of the String parameter 'n' to the instance field 'name'.
closes the setName method
creats a method 'getName' of type String (this type of method is known as a 'getter')
returns name back to the caller.
closes the 'getName' method
end of Person class.
creates a subclass Student that extends the superclass Person
creates a private String 'stuNum'
creates a public method 'setStuNum' that accepts a String input
assigns the value of the String parameter 'sn' to 'stuNum'
closes the 'setStuNum' method.
creates a public method 'getStuNum' of type String (this method is known as a 'getter')
returns the String stuNum to the caller
closes the 'getStuNum' method.
closes the Student subclass.
creates the class 'TestInheritance'
creates the main method of the program
Initializes a new object 'stu' of the Student class.
assigns the String "Sharon Hsiao" to the name of the object 'stu'
assigns the String "12345" to the number of the object 'stu'
prints a single line "Student Name: " plus the name assigned to the object 'stu' via the 'getName' method.
prints a single line "Student Number: " plus the number assigned to the object 'stu' via the 'getStuNum' method.
closes the main method
closes the 'TestInheritance' class
syntax error.  this "}" is not needed
